content: For the purpose of responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunctions 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D or 0x0E, the Dcm shall obtain the DTC with Dem_GetDTCByOccurrenceTime() using the parameter values according to Table 7.21.

For the purpose of responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunctions 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D or 0x0E, the Dcm shall obtain the DTC with Dem_GetDTCByOccurrenceTime() using the parameter values according to Table 7.19.

For the purpose of responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunctions 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D or 0x0E, the Dcm shall obtain the DTC with Dem_GetDTCByOccurrenceTime() using the parameter values according to Table 7.19.

For the purpose of responding to UDS Service 0x19 with subfunctions 0x0B, 0x0C, 0x0D or 0x0E, the Dcm shall obtain the DTC with Dem_GetDTCByOccurrenceTime() using the parameter values according to Table 7.15.
